evidence.reason: The code compares the requested repository-relative path against `git ls-tree --name-only` output split on newlines. Git quotes unusual pathnames by default (non-ASCII, tabs, quotes, newlines under `core.quotePath`), so the quoted output cannot equal `rel` and a real tracked deletion is rejected. Using `-z` and splitting on NUL fixes it. This is an ordinary implementation bug in the stated deletion validation behavior, not a new requirement.
